name: Requesty
summary: Requesty is a hosted LLM gateway with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of 600+ models from 30+ providers. It routes by cost, latency or availability, with failover chains and weighted load balancing. It adds budgets, spend alerts, PII masking and an EU endpoint for data residency.
facts: Provider token prices plus 5% fee on credit top-ups
Cost, latency and availability; failover; load balancing
goodFor: EU data residency for model traffic
watchOut: 5% fee on top of provider prices
